description_en: Enables cold storage for a Lindorm instance, changes node specifications or node counts, or changes the storage capacity
description_zh: 为Lindorm实例开通冷存储，变更节点规格或节点数量，变更存储空间
kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb upgrade-lindorm-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-shanghai-f --instance-id ld-bp1o3y0yme2i20000 --upgrade-type upgrade-cold-storage --cluster-storage 480 --cold-storage 800 --solr-spec lindorm.g.xlarge --solr-num 2 --lindorm-spec lindorm.c.xlarge --lindorm-num 2 --tsdb-spec lindorm.g.xlarge --tsdb-num 2 --filestore-spec lindorm.c.xlarge --filestore-num 2 --stream-spec lindorm.g.xlarge --stream-num 2 --lts-core-spec lindorm.g.xlarge --lts-core-num 2 --core-single-storage 400 --log-spec lindorm.sn1.large --log-num 4 --log-single-storage 400 --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeLindormInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426062.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426067.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426067.html接口获取
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426069.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426069.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of specification change for the instance. For supported types, see the UpgradeType parameter description in the request parameters supplement
parameters.help_zh: 实例需要变配的类型，支持的变配类型请参见请求参数补充中的UpgradeType参数说明
parameters.name: upgrade_type

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the instance after the specification change. Unit: GB. Valid values: 480 to 1017600
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的存储容量，单位为GB，取值：480~1017600
parameters.name: cluster_storage

parameters.help_en: The cold storage capacity of the instance after the specification change. Unit: GB. Valid values: 800 to 1000000
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的冷存储容量，单位为GB，取值：800~1000000
parameters.name: cold_storage

parameters.help_en:
The search index engine node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

lindorm.g.xlarge: 4 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.2xlarge: 8 cores and 32 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.4xlarge: 16 cores and 64 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.8xlarge: 32 cores and 128 GB of memory (dedicated specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的搜索引擎节点规格，取值：

lindorm.g.xlarge：表示4核16GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.2xlarge：表示8核32GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.4xlarge：表示16核64GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.8xlarge：表示32核128GB（独享规格）
parameters.name: solr_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of search index engine nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 60
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的搜索引擎节点数量，取值：0~60
parameters.name: solr_num

parameters.help_en:
The LindormTable engine node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

lindorm.c.xlarge: 4 cores and 8 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.c.2xlarge: 8 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.c.4xlarge: 16 cores and 32 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.c.8xlarge: 32 cores and 64 GB of memory (dedicated specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的宽表引擎节点规格，取值：

lindorm.c.xlarge：表示4核8GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.c.2xlarge：表示8核16GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.c.4xlarge：表示16核32GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.c.8xlarge：表示32核64GB（独享规格）
parameters.name: lindorm_spec

parameters.help_en:
The number of LindormTable nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 90.

This parameter must be specified together with the LindormSpec parameter
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的宽表引擎节点数量，取值：0~90。

本参数需要和LindormSpec参数同时传入
parameters.name: lindorm_num

parameters.help_en:
The LindormTSDB engine node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

lindorm.g.xlarge: 4 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.2xlarge: 8 cores and 32 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.4xlarge: 16 cores and 64 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.8xlarge: 32 cores and 128 GB of memory (dedicated specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的时序引擎节点规格，取值：

lindorm.g.xlarge：表示4核16GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.2xlarge：表示8核32GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.4xlarge：表示16核64GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.8xlarge：表示32核128GB（独享规格）
parameters.name: tsdb_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of LindormTSDB nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 24
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的时序引擎节点数量，取值：0~24
parameters.name: tsdb_num

parameters.help_en:
The file engine node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

indorm.c.xlarge: 4 cores and 8 GB of memory (standard specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的文件引擎节点规格，取值：

indorm.c.xlarge：表示4核8GB（标准规格）
parameters.name: filestore_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of file engine nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 60
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的文件引擎节点数量，取值：0~60
parameters.name: filestore_num

parameters.help_en:
The stream engine node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

lindorm.c.2xlarge: 8 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.c.4xlarge: 16 cores and 32 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.c.8xlarge: 32 cores and 64 GB of memory (dedicated specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的流引擎节点规格，取值：

lindorm.c.2xlarge：表示8核16GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.c.4xlarge：表示16核32GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.c.8xlarge：表示32核64GB（独享规格）
parameters.name: stream_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of stream engine nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 90
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的流引擎节点数量，取值：0~90
parameters.name: stream_num

parameters.help_en:
The LTS node specifications of the instance after the specification change. Valid values:

lindorm.g.xlarge: 4 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.g.2xlarge: 8 cores and 32 GB of memory (dedicated specification)
parameters.help_zh:
变配后实例的LTS节点规格，取值：

lindorm.g.xlarge：表示4核16GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.g.2xlarge：表示8核32GB（独享规格）
parameters.name: lts_core_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of LTS nodes of the instance after the specification change. Valid values: 0 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 变配后实例的LTS节点数量，取值：0~50
parameters.name: lts_core_num

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity per core node of the instance after the specification change for a multi-zone instance. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. Specify this parameter if the target instance is a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，变配后实例的core单节点容量。取值范围400~64000，单位GB。如果目标实例是多可用区实例，选填该参数
parameters.name: core_single_storage

parameters.help_en:
The log node specifications of the instance after the specification change for a multi-zone instance. Valid values:
lindorm.sn1.large: 4 cores and 8 GB of memory (dedicated specification).
lindorm.sn1.2xlarge: 8 cores and 16 GB of memory (dedicated specification).

Specify this parameter if the target instance is a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh:
多可用区实例，变配后实例的log节点规格。取值如下：
lindorm.sn1.large：表示4核8GB（独享规格）。
lindorm.sn1.2xlarge：表示8核16GB（独享规格）。

如果目标实例是多可用区实例，选填该参数
parameters.name: log_spec

parameters.help_en: The number of log nodes of the instance after the specification change for a multi-zone instance. Valid values: 4 to 400. Specify this parameter if the target instance is a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，变配后实例的log节点数量。取值范围4~400。如果目标实例是多可用区实例，选填该参数
parameters.name: log_num

parameters.help_en: The disk capacity per log node of the instance after the specification change for a multi-zone instance. Valid values: 400 to 64000. Unit: GB. Specify this parameter if the target instance is a multi-zone instance
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，变配后实例的log单节点磁盘容量。取值范围400-64000，单位GB。如果目标实例是多可用区实例，选填该参数
parameters.name: log_single_storage
